page.overview:
What is Funtime Freddy?

Funtime Freddy is a minor antagonist in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Fourth Closet.

Funtime Freddy is a sleek metal bear built like Freddy Fazbear. Standing at a height of six feet, he has a gleaming body painted white and accented with a vibrant purple. Funtime Freddy has a large head with a wide-eyed face, yellow eyes, two long rows of polished grinning white teeth, and two rosy cheeks colored bright cotton candy pink. On his chest, at the center of a purple metal shirtfront, is a small, round speaker. Funtime Freddy also has a white plastic plate on his chest cavity. He holds a microphone with a head like a shimmering disco ball. Unlike his game counterpart, Bon-Bon doesn't replace his right hand.

In the poster and graphic novel, Funtime Freddy appears similar to his game counterpart. His head appears to be squarish and less bulky than Withered Freddy's. Funtime Freddy has a purple color on his stomach, shoulders, elbows, knees, insides of his ears, cheeks, thighs, knuckles, palms, the circles on the back of his hands, the top areas of both feet, and the area lining his blue eyes. On the poster Funtime Freddy's accents are bright purple, but in the graphic novel they are mauve. He also has a black top hat lined with a purple stripe, a black bowtie right under his chin, and two black buttons on his stomach.

Funtime Freddy is first seen at the start of Chapter 3, being activated by Baby and William Afton. William then opens the bear's chest cavity and pulls apart his wires. Funtime Freddy shuts down, and Baby gives William a syringe to collect remnant from the amalgamation. Opening his chest cavity again, William injects the remnant into the broken bear, putting him to "greater purpose." This reactivates Funtime Freddy, who looks down at William and Baby and tracks their subtlest movements.
